userStories.title: Migrate existing integrations to Connections table
acceptanceCriteria: Data migration moves all existing integration data to `connections` table
`GitHubSettings` page reads/writes from `connections` table
`GoogleAnalyticsSettings` page reads/writes from `connections` table
`SearchConsoleSettings` page reads/writes from `connections` table
All existing integrations appear as cards in Connections section
GitHub repositories still reference correct connection data
Rollback migration exists to revert if needed
Feature tests cover: migration correctness, settings pages still function, connection CRUD

userStories.title: Completion sync-back to Asana
acceptanceCriteria: `SyncAsanaTaskCompletion` job exists and is queued
Job dispatched when a CR task with `asana_task_id` completes
Job adds a comment to the linked Asana task with completion details
Comment includes PR link if available from task messages
Job moves the Asana task to the configured Testing section
Board page has "Testing section" config dropdown per project
Auto-detection fallback finds sections named "test"/"testing"/"qa"
Graceful failure: if Asana API call fails, job retries without blocking CR task
Feature tests cover: job dispatch on completion, comment creation, section move, auto-detect fallback

userStories.title: Repo-project linking + start CR task from Asana
acceptanceCriteria: Migration adds `asana_project_id` to repositories and `asana_task_id` to tasks
"Link Repository" action on board page with repo dropdown
Linked repo shown on board page (with unlink option)
"Start Claude Runner Task" button in task slide-over panel
Clicking it opens CR task form pre-filled with Asana task title + description
CR task form stores `asana_task_id` on creation
`repository_id` auto-set from linked repo
Feature tests cover: link repo, start CR task pre-fill, asana_task_id stored

userStories.title: Create Asana tasks (inline + full form)
acceptanceCriteria: Each column has a "+ Add task" button/area at the bottom
Inline quick-add accepts a title and creates a task in that section
"Create Task" button opens a full form with all fields
Full form includes: title, description, assignee, due date, tags, section
Created tasks appear on the board immediately (cache busted)
Validation: title required, due date format validated
Feature tests cover: inline create, full form create, validation errors

userStories.title: Kanban drag-and-drop between columns
acceptanceCriteria: Task cards are draggable between columns
Dropping a card in a new column updates the Asana task section via API
Visual feedback during drag (card opacity, drop zone highlight)
Optimistic UI: card moves immediately, reverts on API error with notification
Card order within a column is maintained
Feature tests cover: section update on drop, error handling/revert

userStories.title: Task slide-over panel with edit and delete
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a task card opens a slide-over panel from the right
Panel displays all task details: title, description, assignee, due date, section, tags, subtasks, comments
All editable fields can be modified and saved to Asana API
Section can be changed via dropdown (alternative to drag-and-drop)
Delete action shows confirmation, then removes task from Asana and board
Panel closes on outside click or close button
Loading states shown while fetching full task details
Feature tests cover: panel opens, edit saves, delete removes, section change works

userStories.title: Read-only Asana Kanban board
acceptanceCriteria: "Asana" appears as top-level sidebar item (same level as Tasks, Repositories)
Route `/workbench/asana` loads the board component
Project picker lists all projects grouped by workspace
Selecting a project renders sections as Kanban columns
Task cards display: title, assignee, due date, priority color, tags as pills, subtask count
Board auto-refreshes every 30 seconds via `wire:poll`
API responses cached with ~60s TTL in Laravel cache
Empty states handled (no connection, no projects, empty sections)
Feature tests cover: board renders, project selection, task card display

userStories.title: Connections table + Asana PAT setup
acceptanceCriteria: `connections` migration exists and runs successfully
`Connection` model with encrypted credentials, belongs to User
`ConnectionType` enum with cases: GitHub, GoogleAnalytics, SearchConsole, Asana
Settings page has a "Connections" section showing Asana card
User can enter Asana PAT, click Connect, and see their workspaces
User can select a default workspace and save
PAT is stored encrypted in the `connections` table
Invalid PAT shows validation error
Feature tests cover: creating connection, PAT validation, workspace fetching
